vb_textbox.text: You can recieve anywhere from 0 to 9 mushrooms each round. In the first round, just pick a gnome at random and note 1) the height of the gnome's hat and 2) the amount of mushrooms you recieved. If, for example, you choose a gnome with a tall hat for the first round, and get 5 or more mushrooms, then tall hat gnomes are the 'better gnomes' for now, and you should continue picking the gnomes with tall hats. If you got 4 or less mushrooms from picking a gnome with a tall hat, that means the short hat gnomes are the better gnomes to pick, and so on. Which type of gnome is the 'better gnome' changes every so often, and sometimes neither gnome will give you more than 5 mushrooms for a time. Just go with your instinct when that happens. I managed to get about 1000 points using this method. Good luck to you!
